Interactive Canvas Runtime
|-- Ownership: MappingPage.tsx -> CanvasWorkspace -> CanvasSession per document
|   |-- Page keeps draft metadata, active document ID and stable session handles
|   |   `-- Previously opened editors stay mounted; inactive document views are hidden
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace.setDrafts()
|   |   |-- Seed with document/canvas/history -> create session and register controller
|   |   |-- Retained session -> update saved baseline and metadata
|   |   `-- Removed/replaced session -> unsubscribe, unregister controller, dispose session
|   |-- Workspace subscriptions
|   |   |-- Session commit -> increment changes.version -> notify persistence with document ID
|   |   |-- Document change -> refresh draft entry for search/explorer
|   |   |   `-- Presentation and interaction changes do not take this path
|   |   `-- Status change -> refresh dirty scene IDs
|   `-- Workspace disposal -> unsubscribe listeners and dispose every session
|
|-- Semantic state: CanvasSession owns MappingDocumentController [shared controller]
|   |-- Commands mutate controller; consumers receive read-only store interfaces
|   |   `-- getState / getInitialState / subscribe
|   |-- Controller changes synchronously publish separate reactive stores
|   |   |-- document     -> semantic MappingGridDocument
|   |   |-- presentation -> floating display state + diagram views
|   |   |-- selection    -> application selection membership
|   |   |-- controls     -> canvas controls
|   |   |-- geometry     -> endpoint bounds + cell dimensions + version
|   |   `-- status       -> sceneDirty, isDirty, canUndo, canRedo
|   |-- canvasRevisionId changes -> notify commit listeners
|   |-- Dirty baseline
|   |   |-- sceneDirty = scene differs from saved scene
|   |   |-- isDirty = sceneDirty OR changed edges OR changed name
|   |   `-- Save acknowledgement uses captured saved state, preserving later edits as dirty
|   `-- Headless sessions use the same domain commands without a mounted editor
|
|-- Live interaction: MappingEditorCanvas + MappingEditorRuntime
|   |-- Mount
|   |   |-- Create CanvasRuntime(session); connect to [shared controller]
|   |   |-- Mount tldraw with MappingShapeUtil, custom selection tools and application overlay
|   |   `-- Attach editor driver for settling gestures and native undo/redo
|   |-- Pointer movement -> tldraw owns live geometry
|   |   |-- Shape/selection edits mark runtime dirty
|   |   |-- Pointing, dragging or pinching -> defer idle settling
|   |   `-- No controller commits on pointer-move frames
|   |-- Idle tick or explicit settle -> compare native shapes with last projection
|   |   |-- Moved grid shapes -> move operations, rounded to nonnegative grid coordinates
|   |   |-- Supported diagram clones -> duplicate-instance operations
|   |   |-- Unsupported clones -> remove temporary native copies
|   |   |-- Floating geometry changes -> display positions, bounds and manual placement
|   |   `-- Changed geometry -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |       `-- Semantic checkpoint -> session stores -> workspace persistence notification
|   |-- Selection ownership
|   |   |-- Native selection supports dragging; extra drag diagram IDs stay renderer-local
|   |   `-- Explicit application gestures own content membership
|   |       `-- Pending application selection is preserved during settling
|   |-- Camera
|   |   |-- Reactive overlay transform follows editor camera directly
|   |   `-- Changed camera -> captureViewCamera + SourcePaneViewState.setCamera
|   |       `-- View state is separate from semantic gesture commits
|   |-- Native undo navigation
|   |   |-- Hydrate history with checkpoint references; materialize current shapes lazily
|   |   |-- Store mappingCheckpoint in editor document metadata with shape history
|   |   |-- Undo/redo -> restoreEditorCheckpoint -> reproject without new history entry
|   |   `-- Canvas transfer boundary -> require workspace undo/redo
|   `-- Unmount -> complete and settle editor, detach listeners/driver, dispose routing
|
|-- Semantic-to-render projection
|   |-- projectMappingShapes(controller snapshot)
|   |   |-- presentationScene + diagram views -> flattened visible grid
|   |   |-- Grid cells -> pixel positions and sizes; nested boxes use parent-relative positions
|   |   |-- Stable mapping shape IDs -> mapping-box shapes
|   |   |-- Floating selections, details, projections and conversations -> eligible shapes
|   |   |   `-- Collapsed/docked conversations -> anchored 36 x 36 bubbles
|   |   `-- Connections + alternative side panels -> locked shapes
|   |-- MappingEditorRuntime.publish()
|   |   |-- Diff projected shapes -> create/update/delete only as needed
|   |   |-- Keep edges and side panels above diagram shapes
|   |   |-- New semantic checkpoint -> record command boundary in native history
|   |   `-- Same checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection until interaction settles
|   `-- CanvasRuntimeContext supplies per-entity rendering models
|       |-- Grid, float, edge and side-panel atoms + alternative state
|       |-- shareEqual preserves unchanged branches across cloned domain documents
|       |-- sync() publishes models in one transaction
|       |   |-- Track selected content, collapsed views, stale/missing floating sources
|       |   |-- Resolve semantic edge anchors into owner-local endpoints
|       |   `-- Retain anchors by layout key and clear invalid connection focus
|       `-- Application action callbacks connect shape UI to semantic commands
|
|-- Transient connection routing: NativeRoutingStore
|   |-- Obstacles per diagram
|   |   |-- Matching layout-key measurements override estimated diagram obstacles
|   |   `-- Native shape page transforms -> world-space obstacle rectangles
|   |       `-- Camera changes are not dependencies; no DOM reads or document writes
|   |-- CanvasRuntime edge models -> nativeEdgeInput -> drawAll(inputs)
|   |   |-- Dragging -> previewEdge using last settled routes
|   |   `-- Settled geometry
|   |       |-- No worker -> synchronous ConnectionRouter.drawAll
|   |       |-- Matching completed input/obstacle key -> reuse completed routes
|   |       `-- New key -> queue routing job; return previews while waiting
|   |-- Worker scheduling
|   |   |-- One job in flight; keep only newest pending request
|   |   |-- Completion matches latest requested key -> publish routes
|   |   `-- Stale completion -> discard result, dispatch pending job
|   `-- Worker failure -> terminate and disable worker; subsequent draws route synchronously
|
`-- MappingPage integration boundaries
    |-- Storage
    |   |-- WorkspacePersistence connects workspace changes to storage records
    |   |-- Workspace operations can pause persistence; resume -> update and sync
    |   `-- Publish saved canvas
    |       `-- Capture checkpoint -> sync + flush -> recheck version
    |           `-- publishMappingCheckpoint -> update captured saved baseline
    |-- Agent API
    |   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge registers visible documents and dispatches commands
    |   |-- Reads expose identity, context, snapshots and current canvas state
    |   `-- Mutations reach [shared controller], revision receivers or canvas-view receiver
    |       |-- Version/busy checks and request receipts guard supported command paths
    |       `-- Creation/context receipts survive flush failure for same-request retry
    `-- Chat
        |-- AgentChatPanel receives active session and workspace/document target
        |-- Copy diagram -> stage ASCII in active session's cursorCopy
        `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas hosts local chat interactions within the editor
